conventions.tone: 学习文本平实准确；歌词偏口语化
conventions.proper_nouns: 使用通行译法（東京→东京）；无通行译法时保留日文原文
conventions.kana: 翻译行出现平假名/片假名视为漏译（专名或引用可保留）
conventions.notes: 逐句对应，不合并、不拆分组，不加译注或赏析

conventions.tone: idiomatic; singable for lyrics when requested, otherwise faithful prose
conventions.proper_nouns: Hepburn romanization; use established English names when they exist
conventions.kana: kana in a translation line usually means an untranslated fragment
conventions.notes: one line per source line; preserve blank-line grouping; no footnotes
